sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 18 July 2024, pitch SYN-SYNCP000082-P1 was put before Maple Grove Regional Hospital 082 on behalf of PFIZER.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 2 rebate of 3 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Pneumococcal minimum take of 360 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer came back with a counter.
